processes:task-eo-operate-intake-rb444r.plain_language_name: Receive the Approved Requisitions for Placement
processes:task-eo-operate-intake-rb444r.plain_language_description: Placement opens when the approved requisitions are handed over as the demand the suppliers will be asked to fill. The intake custodian accepts them, registers them with audit identifiers, and starts the placement from a recorded baseline.
processes:task-eo-operate-intake-rb444r.business_purpose: It exists so orders are placed from approved demand rather than from informal requests.
processes:task-eo-operate-intake-rb444r.practical_context: It opens when the approved requisitions are presented for placement, with the activity owner alerted, and it closes with the intake registered and the later steps cleared to proceed.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian registers the approved requisitions as the placement baseline, with audit references, and opens the ordering work.

processes:task-eo-operate-transform-2kmu.plain_language_name: Place the Orders with the Approved Suppliers
processes:task-eo-operate-transform-2kmu.plain_language_description: With the requisitions verified, the processing custodian does the placement itself: each approval is converted into a purchase order and placed with its supplier, and the placed orders are set down in the form the activity defines. Working papers are preserved for audit.
processes:task-eo-operate-transform-2kmu.business_purpose: It exists because an approval buys nothing - placement is where the demand becomes a supplier's obligation.
processes:task-eo-operate-transform-2kmu.practical_context: It starts once checking is complete and the verified requisitions are ready to be placed, and it ends with the placed orders produced and the working papers kept.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in product management turns each approval into an order with its supplier, keeping the working papers.

processes:task-eo-operate-verify-wkr4d3.plain_language_name: Check the Approvals Before Placing the Orders
processes:task-eo-operate-verify-wkr4d3.plain_language_description: Before anything is placed, the verification custodian checks the requisitions against what placement requires - that each is genuinely approved and within its budget line. Defects are logged for rejection or repair before any order is placed.
processes:task-eo-operate-verify-wkr4d3.business_purpose: It exists so suppliers are never handed obligations the enterprise never actually approved.
processes:task-eo-operate-verify-wkr4d3.practical_context: It runs once the intake is registered and the requisitions can be compared with the activity's requirements, and it finishes with them verified or their defects logged for rejection or remediation.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian finds a requisition approved past its budget line and logs the defect before any order is placed.

processes:task-eo-operate-record-fexcdk.plain_language_name: File the Procurement Compliance Audit Record
processes:task-eo-operate-record-fexcdk.plain_language_description: At the close the records custodian preserves the watch trail at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles for it. What the buying looked like at each pass, and what was put right, stays readable whenever the flow's integrity is examined.
processes:task-eo-operate-record-fexcdk.business_purpose: It exists so the flow's integrity can be evidenced whenever its conduct is questioned.
processes:task-eo-operate-record-fexcdk.practical_context: It starts once the confirmation has been issued and retention may begin under the activity's evidence requirements, and it ends with the audit record preserved at its tier and retrieval handles standing.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian files the watch trail at its retention tier and sets the retrieval handles a procurement review would consult.

processes:task-eo-operate-confirm-wvcbmd.plain_language_description: When the watching stands done, the confirmation custodian reconciles the compliance position against the outcome the activity set out to reach and issues the confirmation. The procurement chain learns where the buying stands clean and where it drifts.
processes:task-eo-operate-confirm-wvcbmd.business_purpose: It exists so the chain relies only on a position confirmed as held.
processes:task-eo-operate-confirm-wvcbmd.practical_context: It begins once preparation is complete and the compliance position awaits its consumers, and it closes with the confirmation issued, consumers told, and the result reconciled to the activity's promise.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian reconciles the compliance position against the activity's intended outcome and issues the confirmation the procurement chain needs.

processes:task-eo-operate-intake-ggf87d.plain_language_name: Receive the Purchasing Flow and the Policy
processes:task-eo-operate-intake-ggf87d.plain_language_description: The watch opens when the purchasing flow and the procurement policy are handed over together as the two sides the compliance work will read between. The intake custodian accepts both, registers them with audit identifiers, and starts the watching from a recorded base.
processes:task-eo-operate-intake-ggf87d.business_purpose: It exists so the buying is watched against a registered policy rather than against memory.
processes:task-eo-operate-intake-ggf87d.practical_context: It opens when the flow and policy are presented for the watch, with the activity owner alerted, and it closes with the intake registered and the later steps cleared to proceed.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian registers the purchasing flow and the policy as the watch baseline, with audit references, and opens the watching work.

processes:task-eo-operate-transform-8xjk.plain_language_name: Watch the Buying and Put Right What Drifts
processes:task-eo-operate-transform-8xjk.plain_language_description: With the inputs verified, the processing custodian does the watching itself: the operating buying flow is read against the policy, drifts are put right as they are found, and the maintained position is set down in the form the activity defines. Working papers are preserved for audit.
processes:task-eo-operate-transform-8xjk.business_purpose: It exists because purchasing drifts one convenient shortcut at a time - the watch is what keeps the buying honest.
processes:task-eo-operate-transform-8xjk.practical_context: It starts once checking is complete and the verified inputs are ready to be watched, and it ends with the maintained position produced and the working papers kept.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in product management reads the buying against the policy and puts each drift right as it is found, keeping the working papers.

processes:task-eo-operate-verify-q4twsh.plain_language_name: Check the Policy Before Watching the Buying
processes:task-eo-operate-verify-q4twsh.plain_language_description: Before the watching begins, the verification custodian checks the policy and flow against what the watch demands - that the policy is the current one and the flow's records are complete enough to read. Defects are logged for rejection or repair before the watching starts.
processes:task-eo-operate-verify-q4twsh.business_purpose: It exists so the buying is never judged against a policy that was superseded.
processes:task-eo-operate-verify-q4twsh.practical_context: It runs once the intake is registered and the inputs can be compared with the activity's requirements, and it finishes with them verified or their defects logged for rejection or remediation.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian finds the flow's records missing a supplier's transactions and logs the defect before the watching starts.

processes:task-eo-operate-record-nkzbm7.plain_language_name: File the Requisition Processing Audit Record
processes:task-eo-operate-record-nkzbm7.plain_language_description: At the close the records custodian preserves the processing trail at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles for it. What was asked, how it was validated, and who approved it, stays readable whenever a purchase's origins are examined.
processes:task-eo-operate-record-nkzbm7.business_purpose: It exists so the origins of every purchase can be evidenced whenever they are questioned.
processes:task-eo-operate-record-nkzbm7.practical_context: It starts once the confirmation has been issued and retention may begin under the activity's evidence requirements, and it ends with the audit record preserved at its tier and retrieval handles standing.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian files the processing trail at its retention tier and sets the retrieval handles a purchase review would consult.

processes:task-eo-operate-confirm-qews37.plain_language_description: When the asks stand validated, the confirmation custodian reconciles the approved requisitions against the outcome the activity set out to reach and issues the confirmation. The placement side learns what is approved and ready to be ordered.
processes:task-eo-operate-confirm-qews37.business_purpose: It exists so orders are placed only from requisitions confirmed as approved.
processes:task-eo-operate-confirm-qews37.practical_context: It begins once preparation is complete and the approved requisitions await their consumers, and it closes with the confirmation issued, consumers informed, and the result reconciled to the activity's promise.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian reconciles the approved requisitions against the activity's intended outcome and issues the confirmation the placement side needs.

processes:task-eo-operate-intake-u2fme3.plain_language_description: Processing opens when the incoming purchase requisitions are handed over as the asks waiting to be validated and approved. The intake custodian accepts them, registers them with audit identifiers, and starts the processing from a recorded baseline.
processes:task-eo-operate-intake-u2fme3.business_purpose: It exists so demand enters the buying flow through a registered gate rather than around it.
processes:task-eo-operate-intake-u2fme3.practical_context: It opens when the incoming requisitions are presented for processing, with the activity owner alerted, and it closes with the intake registered and the later steps cleared to proceed.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian registers the incoming requisitions as the processing baseline, with audit references, and opens the validation work.

processes:task-eo-operate-transform-8yfz.plain_language_name: Validate Each Ask Against Policy and Budget
processes:task-eo-operate-transform-8yfz.plain_language_description: With the asks verified, the processing custodian does the processing itself: each requisition is checked for its policy footing and its budget line, approved where it fits, and the approved set is set down in the form the activity defines. Working papers are preserved for audit.
processes:task-eo-operate-transform-8yfz.business_purpose: It exists because every purchase starts as somebody's ask - validation is what keeps the asks honest before they cost money.
processes:task-eo-operate-transform-8yfz.practical_context: It starts once checking is complete and the verified asks are ready to be validated, and it ends with the approved requisitions produced and the working papers kept.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in product management checks each ask against policy and budget and approves what fits, keeping the working papers.

processes:task-eo-operate-verify-an7292.plain_language_name: Check the Requisitions Before Validating Them
processes:task-eo-operate-verify-an7292.plain_language_description: Before anything is validated, the verification custodian checks the incoming asks against what processing requires - that each states its need, its requester, and its amount. Defects are logged for rejection or repair before the validation begins.
processes:task-eo-operate-verify-an7292.business_purpose: It exists so nobody validates an ask too thin to judge.
processes:task-eo-operate-verify-an7292.practical_context: It runs once the intake is registered and the asks can be compared with the activity's requirements, and it finishes with them verified or their defects logged for rejection or remediation.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian finds an ask that states no amount and logs the defect before validation begins.

processes:task-eo-operate-record-4xmkw9.plain_language_description: At the close the records custodian preserves the receipt trail at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles for it. What arrived, in what condition, and against which order, stays readable whenever a payment or a dispute turns on it.
processes:task-eo-operate-record-4xmkw9.business_purpose: It exists so the receipt of every delivery can be evidenced whenever a payment or dispute turns on it.
processes:task-eo-operate-record-4xmkw9.practical_context: It starts once the confirmation has been issued and retention may begin under the activity's evidence requirements, and it ends with the audit record preserved at its tier and retrieval handles standing.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian files the receipt trail at its retention tier and sets the retrieval handles a payment dispute would consult.

processes:task-eo-operate-confirm-ccsz6z.plain_language_description: When the deliveries stand checked, the confirmation custodian reconciles the verified receipts against the outcome the activity set out to reach and issues the confirmation. The payment side learns what arrived in good order and can settle against it.
processes:task-eo-operate-confirm-ccsz6z.business_purpose: It exists so payment proceeds only over receipts confirmed as verified.
processes:task-eo-operate-confirm-ccsz6z.practical_context: It begins once preparation is complete and the verified receipts await their consumers, and it closes with the confirmation issued, consumers informed, and the result reconciled to the activity's promise.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian reconciles the verified receipts against the activity's intended outcome and issues the confirmation the payment side needs.

processes:task-eo-operate-intake-uma7mh.plain_language_description: Receipt opens when the arriving supplier deliveries are handed over as the goods to be checked at the gate. The intake custodian accepts them, registers them with audit identifiers, and starts the verification from a recorded baseline.
processes:task-eo-operate-intake-uma7mh.business_purpose: It exists so deliveries are checked from a registered arrival list rather than from the loading dock's memory.
processes:task-eo-operate-intake-uma7mh.practical_context: It opens when the arriving deliveries are presented for receipt, with the activity owner alerted, and it closes with the intake registered and the later steps cleared to proceed.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian registers the arriving deliveries as the receipt baseline, with audit references, and opens the checking work.

processes:task-eo-operate-transform-zb37.plain_language_name: Check Each Delivery Against Its Order
processes:task-eo-operate-transform-zb37.plain_language_description: With the arrivals verified, the processing custodian does the receipt itself: each delivery is opened, counted, and compared with the order that called for it, and the verified receipts are set down in the form the activity defines. Working papers are preserved for audit.
processes:task-eo-operate-transform-zb37.business_purpose: It exists because paying for what did not arrive is the quietest way to lose money - the check at the gate is what keeps the books true.
processes:task-eo-operate-transform-zb37.practical_context: It starts once checking is complete and the verified arrivals are ready to be received, and it ends with the verified receipts produced and the working papers kept.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in product management opens and counts each delivery against its order and records the receipt, keeping the working papers.

processes:task-eo-operate-verify-xrnqux.plain_language_name: Check the Arrivals Before Verifying Them
processes:task-eo-operate-verify-xrnqux.plain_language_description: Before anything is checked in, the verification custodian checks the arriving deliveries against what receipt requires - that each names its order and its supplier. Defects are logged for rejection or repair before the verifying begins.
processes:task-eo-operate-verify-xrnqux.business_purpose: It exists so nothing is checked in against an order nobody can produce.
processes:task-eo-operate-verify-xrnqux.practical_context: It runs once the intake is registered and the arrivals can be compared with the activity's requirements, and it finishes with them verified or their defects logged for rejection or remediation.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian finds an arrival with no order behind it and logs the defect before the checking begins.

processes:task-eo-operate-record-d934av.plain_language_description: At the close the records custodian preserves the disposition trail at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles for it. What was found failing, and what became of it, stays readable whenever a batch's history is examined.
processes:task-eo-operate-record-d934av.business_purpose: It exists so the fate of every failing output can be evidenced whenever a batch's history is questioned.
processes:task-eo-operate-record-d934av.practical_context: It starts once the confirmation has been issued and retention may begin under the activity's evidence requirements, and it ends with the audit record preserved at its tier and retrieval handles standing.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian files the disposition trail at its retention tier and sets the retrieval handles a quality review would consult.

processes:task-eo-operate-confirm-myjdfs.plain_language_description: When the fates stand decided, the confirmation custodian reconciles them against the outcome the activity set out to reach and issues the confirmation. Production and the quality chain learn which output is contained, which is reworked, and which is gone.
processes:task-eo-operate-confirm-myjdfs.business_purpose: It exists so output is treated as settled only once its disposition is confirmed.
processes:task-eo-operate-confirm-myjdfs.practical_context: It begins once preparation is complete and the settled dispositions await their consumers, and it closes with the confirmation issued, consumers informed, and the result reconciled to the activity's promise.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian reconciles the settled dispositions against the activity's intended outcome and issues the confirmation the quality chain needs.

processes:task-eo-operate-intake-e9d8gx.plain_language_name: Receive the Recorded Nonconformities for Disposition
processes:task-eo-operate-intake-e9d8gx.plain_language_description: Disposition opens when the recorded nonconformities are handed over as the failures awaiting their fate. The intake custodian accepts them, registers them with audit identifiers, and starts the deciding work from a recorded baseline.
processes:task-eo-operate-intake-e9d8gx.business_purpose: It exists so failing output is decided over from a registered record rather than from the floor's mood.
processes:task-eo-operate-intake-e9d8gx.practical_context: It opens when the recorded nonconformities are presented for disposition, with the activity owner alerted, and it closes with the intake registered and the later steps cleared to proceed.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian registers the recorded nonconformities as the disposition baseline, with audit references, and opens the deciding work.

processes:task-eo-operate-transform-zurf.plain_language_name: Decide What Becomes of the Failed Output
processes:task-eo-operate-transform-zurf.plain_language_description: With the nonconformities verified, the processing custodian does the deciding itself: each failing output is judged to its fate - accepted with concession, reworked, scrapped, or sent back - with affected batches contained, and the dispositions are set down in the form the activity defines. Working papers are preserved for audit.
processes:task-eo-operate-transform-zurf.business_purpose: It exists because failing output that lingers undecided finds its own way to a customer - the disposition is what decides, deliberately, before that happens.
processes:task-eo-operate-transform-zurf.practical_context: It starts once checking is complete and the verified nonconformities are ready to be decided, and it ends with the settled dispositions produced and the working papers kept.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in product management judges each failing output to its fate and contains the affected batches, keeping the working papers.

processes:task-eo-operate-verify-e96x96.plain_language_name: Check the Nonconformities Before Deciding Their Fate
processes:task-eo-operate-verify-e96x96.plain_language_description: Before anything is judged, the verification custodian checks the nonconformities against what disposition requires - that each states what failed, where, and how much output it touches. Defects are logged for rejection or repair before the deciding begins.
processes:task-eo-operate-verify-e96x96.business_purpose: It exists so no output is judged on a record too thin to decide from.
processes:task-eo-operate-verify-e96x96.practical_context: It runs once the intake is registered and the nonconformities can be compared with the activity's requirements, and it finishes with them verified or their defects logged for rejection or remediation.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian finds a nonconformity that states no affected quantity and logs the defect before the deciding begins.

processes:task-eo-operate-record-b9km22.plain_language_name: File the Inspection Results Audit Record
processes:task-eo-operate-record-b9km22.plain_language_description: At the close the records custodian preserves the inspection trail at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles for it. What was tested, what was measured, and per which batch, stays readable whenever a quality claim is examined.
processes:task-eo-operate-record-b9km22.business_purpose: It exists so the measurements behind every quality judgement can be evidenced whenever a claim is questioned.
processes:task-eo-operate-record-b9km22.practical_context: It starts once the confirmation has been issued and retention may begin under the activity's evidence requirements, and it ends with the audit record preserved at its tier and retrieval handles standing.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian files the inspection trail at its retention tier and sets the retrieval handles a quality review would consult.
